Get ACB Playoff Series

Source: R/acb.R
acb_serie.Rd

The playoff series a game belongs to, one row per game of the series (HTTP 204 outside a series).

One row per game of the series: match_id is that game and requested_match_id the game asked for (every row repeats it). home_team_id / away_team_id are the team entries of THAT game, series_home_* the team with home court. series_home_wins / series_away_wins are the series wins, best_of the series length as sent (0 in the 2016-17 final sample: read it as unknown). A game outside a series answers HTTP 204 (hoopR_no_data).

Endpoint: GET https://api2.acb.com/api/matchdata/Overview/serie

Usage

acb_serie(match_id)

Arguments

match_id

(required) ACB match id (integer), one global sequence for every competition: legacy ids (seasons up to 2019-20) sit below about 20000 (12559 = the 2005-06 final); ids from 2020-21 start around 100000 (105401 = Barca 89-86 Valencia Basket, Liga 2026-27 round 3). A whole number; a whole double is accepted.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble, one row per record described above; the columns are always these, in this order (sportsdataverse-py acb_serie):

col_nametypedescription
requested_match_idintegerThe match asked for (any game of the series); every row of the series repeats it.
phase_idintegerPhase id of the series (111 = Play Off Titulo).
subphase_idintegerSub-phase id of the series (the playoff stage).
series_home_team_idintegerSeason-team entry of the series' home-court team (new every season).
series_home_club_idintegerStable club id of the series' home-court team.
series_away_team_idintegerSeason-team entry of the other team of the series.
series_away_club_idintegerStable club id of the other team of the series.
series_home_winsintegerGames won by the home-court team in the series (the API's homeScore).
series_away_winsintegerGames won by the other team in the series (the API's awayScore).
series_finishedlogicalTrue once the series is decided.
best_ofintegerSeries length (best of N) as sent; 0 in the 2016-17 final sample, so read 0 as unknown.
edition_idintegerSeason id (editionId) = season START year - 1935 (91 = 2026-27). The wrappers take the END year, season.
seasonintegerSeason END year (2027 = 2026-27) = edition_id + 1936: the key the wrappers take.
match_idintegerACB match id of this game of the series.
home_team_idintegerHome season-team entry of THIS game (the series' home-court team is series_home_team_id).
away_team_idintegerAway season-team entry of THIS game.
home_scoreintegerHome points of this game.
away_scoreintegerAway points of this game.
startPOSIXctTip-off instant (UTC).
statuscharacterGame state: FINALIZED once over.
is_on_half_timelogicalTrue during the half-time break of a live game.
current_quarterintegerCurrent or last period of the game (4 for a finished regulation game).

Details

Source, terms of use, request pacing, seasons, ids, coverage and error classes of this family: see the notes in acb_match_header().

 acb_serie(match_id = 17718)
